description: This file defines the DeviceRepository interface for accessing device data in a SQL database, including various query methods for retrieving device info, filtering by tenant, customer, profile, type, and relations, as well as counting and batch processing.

classes.name: DeviceRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for device entities, extending JpaRepository and providing custom query methods for device data retrieval and filtering.

methods.name: findDeviceInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves device info entity by device ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant and customer IDs with optional text search.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndProfileId
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant ID and device profile ID with optional text search.

methods.name: findDeviceInfosByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Finds device info entities by tenant and customer IDs with optional text search.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant ID with pagination.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndType
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant ID and device type with optional text search.

methods.name: findIdsByTenantIdAndDeviceProfileId
methods.description: Finds device IDs by tenant ID and device profile ID with optional text search.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndTypeAndFirmwareIdIsNull
methods.description: Finds devices with null firmware ID by tenant and profile ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndTypeAndSoftwareIdIsNull
methods.description: Finds devices with null software ID by tenant and profile ID.

methods.name: countByTenantIdAndDeviceProfileIdAndFirmwareIdIsNull
methods.description: Counts devices with null firmware ID by tenant and profile ID.

methods.name: countByTenantIdAndDeviceProfileIdAndSoftwareIdIsNull
methods.description: Counts devices with null software ID by tenant and profile ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndCustomerIdAndType
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant, customer, and type with optional text search.

methods.name: findDeviceInfosByFilter
methods.description: Finds device info entities based on multiple filters including tenant, customer, edge, type, profile, activity, and text search.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds a device by tenant ID and name.

methods.name: findEntityInfosByNamePrefix
methods.description: Finds entity info objects with names starting with a given prefix.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndCustomerIdAndIdIn
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant, customer, and list of device IDs.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndIdIn
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant ID and list of device IDs.

methods.name: findDevicesByIdIn
methods.description: Finds devices by list of device IDs.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndId
methods.description: Finds a device by tenant ID and device ID.

methods.name: countByDeviceProfileId
methods.description: Counts devices associated with a specific device profile.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndEdgeId
methods.description: Finds devices related to a specific edge ID with optional text search.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndEdgeIdAndType
methods.description: Finds devices related to a specific edge ID and type with optional text search.

methods.name: countByTenantId
methods.description: Counts devices by tenant ID, optimized for performance.

methods.name: findIdsByDeviceProfileTransportType
methods.description: Finds device IDs by transport type.

methods.name: getExternalIdById
methods.description: Retrieves external ID for a device by device ID.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of device fields after a given ID for batch processing.
